comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic finishing media from steel washers; pr-1570 adjusts a wrench jaw, loosens a nut in the safe direction, removes the wrench, and sets it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual screen control, agitation, many-body retention/pass-through behavior, and reseating; pr-1570 requires fine worm adjustment, correct fixed-jaw loading, torque application, and tool removal. Shared grasping and set-down are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered mass, washer retention, no spill or break, support seating, release clearance, and dwell; pr-1570 grades nut rotation and wrench set-down while permanently rejecting loose-jaw or wrong-direction pulls. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Adjustable-wrench fitting and torque application do not test bulk selective separation or loose-body dynamics.
